sampling.observations: creation commit; latest commit strictly before 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January following each year 2008–2025; frozen endpoint for partial 2026

scope.partial_types: class declarations; do not merge parts
scope.tests_and_tools: all paths outside the production prefix excluded from measurements
scope.component_policy: one central production component with explicit rename/successor mapping

framework.policy: original default production project; for multitargeting select its first declared TargetFrameworks entry
framework.implicit_legacy_default: v2.0 only for the verified VS2005 project format with no explicit target
framework.transitions: record and annotate; no attribution of changes solely to source evolution
framework.references: exact selected target reference files with SHA-256; retain copies in replay bundle

measurement.obsolete_api_unit: distinct obsolete referenced symbol per source file under the existing detector
normalisation: flagged class declarations / eligible class declarations
flagged method declarations / eligible method declarations
production files with obsolete API findings / eligible production files
measurement.source_size: physical lines including blanks/comments, reported separately; not a complexity surrogate
measurement.valid_zero: complete with explicit empty findings and zero counts; zero denominators yield null rates

adapter.strategy: export evaluated Csc command-line arguments using installed MSBuild; reconstruct compilation with the unchanged HybridLens detector sources and frozen Roslyn; retain original source, defines and reference APIs
adapter.sdk_selector_adaptation: use explicitly recorded SDK build invocation from outside snapshot SDK discovery; if a selector needs an override, it must be scripted and recorded
adapter.generated_sources: retain as semantic support; exclude from measured findings/denominators
adapter.compiler_errors: any parser/reference/compilation error prevents complete status
adapter.analyzer_generators: do not silently omit required generated declarations; require clean reconstructed compilation
adapter.deterministic_dependency_builds: Deterministic=true, ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true, DeterministicSourcePaths=false, and per-snapshot root mapped to /_/; required for byte-identical locally built project references.

reproducibility.compare: canonical complete measurements, findings, denominators, source/reference hashes and effective compiler settings
reproducibility.offline_replay: reconstruct and rescan from archived source, compiler arguments, reference assemblies and frozen scanner without repository or NuGet access
reproducibility.frozen_analyser: source snapshot and SHA-256 inventory, not Git HEAD alone

inference: descriptive prevalence in one purposively selected library; no individual persistence, repair, causality or population-generalisation claims
full_study_gate: all 20 snapshots complete in both independent directories and offline replay

amendment.reason: Apply the exact annual detector, denominator, validity and reproducibility parameters to a comparison repository.
amendment.scope_choice: MixBrowser at the preserved root, then the renamed central OpenRA game-engine project.
amendment.comparability_limit: This is a longitudinal primary-component scope, not every production project in the repository.
amendment.conditional_framework_resolution: For dotnet/MSBuild (non-Mono), use net5.0 in 2021 and net6.0 in 2022–2024; the project files condition these against Mono alternatives.

archive.reason: Exclude game/media assets outside compiler evaluation; every compiler-consumed source and reference is sealed in replay.
